Typlune Privacy Policy

Effective date: 2026-08-15

Typlune is designed to keep the user experience simple and privacy-aware.

Data collection: Typlune does not sell personal data and does not use third-party analytics. The extension only uses permissions required for its stated browser features.

Local processing: Where possible, extension actions are handled locally in the browser.

Support contact: For privacy questions, contact yonalsolutions@gmail.com or Telegram https://t.me/websipX.

Changes: If this policy changes, the effective date will be updated on this page.
